message: `|| echo ...` as the last step prints a note when the command fails and then succeeds, so the failure no longer changes the exit status
help: stop the line on failure: `cmd || { echo 'cmd failed' >&2; exit 1; }`; keep `|| echo` only when the message is the whole report
notes: `|| echo` was how two CI steps in kapsel#143 passed while the build or signature check had failed
